item.text:
**Verdict:** **Yes, strongly, with a major caveat.** AMLO did mobilize the state apparatus, bureaucracy, welfare machinery, and parts of the military effectively toward his chosen 4T program in 2024. The caveat is that the same mobilization also served coalition entrenchment, surveillance, and institutional weakening.

## Accepted Claims

- [Presidente anuncia aumentos en Programas para el Bienestar en presupuesto de 2024; todas las obras públicas se terminarán, afirma](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-anuncia-aumentos-en-programas-para-el-bienestar-en-presupuesto-de-2024-todas-las-obras-publicas-se-terminaran-afirma/) | Presidencia de México | 2023-09-07 | Claim: AMLO translated the program into a concrete 2024 budget with higher welfare spending, completed public works, and pay increases for health/education workers. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.2

- [02.01.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador, desde Tabasco](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/02-01-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador-desde-tabasco/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-01-02 | Claim: He set explicit final-term priorities and used the presidency to coordinate universal health care, public works, and basification of teachers and health workers. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.2, 8B.1

- [IMSS-Bienestar opera en 23 entidades para atender a 53.2 millones de mexicanos que no tienen seguridad social](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202404/170) | IMSS | 2024-04-17 | Claim: The government operationalized IMSS-Bienestar as a large nationwide delivery system with defined coverage, facilities, workforce, and staff-basification, showing real bureaucratic mobilization. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.2

- [IMSS-Bienestar, legado del presidente al pueblo de México, se va a consolidar en el próximo sexenio: Zoé Robledo](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202409/490) | IMSS | 2024-09-24 | Claim: The administration reported large staffing/facility expansion in IMSS-Bienestar, indicating that the health bureaucracy was being mobilized at scale toward the welfare program. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.2

- [Banco del Bienestar suma 26.5 millones de cuentas por Programas para el Bienestar](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/banco-del-bienestar-distribuye-26-5-millones-de-tarjetas-para-pago-de-pensiones-becas-y-apoyos-del-gobierno-de-la-4t/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-05 | Claim: Benefits were pushed through millions of direct accounts, which is a concrete state delivery mechanism that reduced dependence on intermediaries and made the program operationally effective. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.2, 7B.9

- [Programas para el Bienestar: tarjetas del Banco del Bienestar no se renovarán con cambio de administración](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/tarjeta-del-banco-del-bienestar-no-caigas-en-fraudes-no-hay-campanas-de-renovacion/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-09-10 | Claim: The outgoing government designed continuity through the transition so payments would keep flowing, showing administrative handoff discipline rather than a one-off electoral stunt. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.2, 8B.1

- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasión fiscal de Totalplay; debe más de mil 500 millones de pesos al SAT](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-03-15 | Claim: The state apparatus was used to enforce rules against a politically connected firm, showing that the government could mobilize enforcement capacity toward its anti-privilege agenda. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.2, 7B.9

- [Presidente López Obrador y virtual presidenta electa Sheinbaum alistan transición y reformas para continuar la 4T](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-lopez-obrador-y-virtual-presidenta-electa-sheinbaum-alistan-transicion-y-reformas-para-continuar-la-4t/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-10 | Claim: AMLO and Sheinbaum publicly coordinated transition and continuity, showing the ruling coalition and state apparatus were aligned behind the program. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.2, 8B.1

## Counterevidence

- [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with super-majority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) | Reuters | 2024-06-04 | Claim: Reuters reported the INE overhaul and related reforms were seen by critics as a way to cement Morena hegemony, so mobilization also served regime entrenchment. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.1, 8B.2

- [Mexico's sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) | Reuters | 2024-09-15 | Claim: The judiciary reform was publicly sold as citizen-serving but criticized as weakening judicial independence, meaning the state machine was also being used to reduce neutral constraints. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.1, 8B.2

- [Mexico - Digital News Report 2024](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | Claim: The final-year media climate included attacks on journalists and the NYT phone-number episode, suggesting mobilization of narrative pressure alongside policy execution. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.1

- [Informe Mundial 2024: México](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | Claim: HRW said AMLO moved many functions into military hands and blocked INAI appointments, which is effective mobilization but toward concentration and weaker oversight, not just program delivery. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.1, 8B.2

- [Programa para el Bienestar: evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18 | Claim: The government advanced welfare payments before the blackout, which shows electoral timing and patronage sensitivity inside the mobilization strategy. | QIDs: 8B.3, 7B.9, 8B.2

- [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-2024-10-16/) | Reuters | 2024-10-16 | Claim: Soldiers killed six migrants, showing that the security apparatus was mobilized aggressively and sometimes produced lethal abuse rather than disciplined implementation. | QIDs: 8B.3, 8B.1, 7B.9

## Synthesis

AMLO’s 2024 ruling apparatus was **highly effective** at turning the 4T into state action:
- welfare money moved through large direct-payment systems,
- IMSS-Bienestar expanded as a real bureaucracy,
- enforcement was used against selected business targets,
- the transition to Sheinbaum was coordinated,
- and the governing coalition remained intact.

At the same time, the same mobilization extended into:
- judicial and electoral overhauls,
- military expansion into civilian functions,
- surveillance and hostile treatment of scrutiny,
- and election-sensitive benefit timing.

So for **8B.3**, the answer is **yes, effectively mobilized**, but the mobilization was not cleanly program-only; it also served power-consolidation goals.

## Search Gap

I found strong evidence on welfare administration, bureaucracy, military/logistical reach, and coalition control, but no single independent 2024 source that scores the whole mobilization chain end-to-end. The best evidence is a mix of official implementation documents and independent reporting on the main countervailing institutions.
